summary: Source review found no product defect: the desktop-only CSS follows the agreed wrapping, padding and ellipsis requirements, preserves the merged separate save-row placement, and leaves mobile rules, shared navigation, other pages, labels and handlers unchanged. The revised suite resolves the earlier inventory, hit-testing and bilingual interaction findings; the implementation report supplies the requested measurements and screenshot observations. Root npm test discovers 210 tests, including all 53 task cases; node tests/verify.js and git diff --check passed. However, independent browser verification is blocked: all 53 cases exited before page execution because Chromium failed at sandbox_host_linux.cc:41 with shutdown: Operation not permitted. The tester reports a successful prior run, but this review cannot confirm its layout results and therefore records fail for the environment blocker, not a demonstrated layout regression. The reports' Git commit blocker is historical: commits 68e4d04 and 76b0f6a are present and the working tree was clean at review start.
findings: Complete final browser verification in an authorized environment where Chromium can launch: run npm test -- tests/02-adapt-the-menu-for-small-screens/laptop-header.spec.js against the reviewed branch and retain the results and requested screenshots for review. Resolve the execution-environment restriction without changing product CSS or weakening assertions; the current 53 launch failures provide no page-layout measurements.
